_doc: Stable output schema of acts.stage4.analysis.run_all (version 1). run_all.validate_outputs checks the required keys and types of every file it wrote; Stage-5 figure code reads only the keys listed here. Units: probabilities per trial (one PU-200 event, one MET road), B in events in 3 ab^-1, times in ns, lengths in mm. v2 (2026-10-14, round 3): Stage-5 proposed_schema additions (acceptance, bands, factor breakdown, discovery, edges, sep_IT, event display).

signal_obs_<kind>.npz.note: one row per signal-matched candidate (f_CKF stored, not applied); Stage 5 selects with L/FB and f_ckf < 0.2

signal_rows_<kind>.npz.note: per-row event pass matrices for the row-level bootstrap jointly across Lambda (plan §4.1)

required.oot_checks: dict kind -> {N_B1, n_lookups, n_lookups_missing_file, frac_rows_missing_file, n_oot_inband_hits, n_earliest_oot, pass_}

required.label: str
required.end_state: list[43] {column, P_per_trial, sigma_ln, sigma_ln_components, closure_factor, base_method, zero_branch}

required.columns: dict column -> {own, late_population, P_late {N, M}, oot_population, P_oot {N, M, n_km}, sigma_ln_PV, sigma_ln_sigma_t}

required.label: str
required.ladder: dict {T: list[23], G: list[23], FB: dict, missing_inputs: list, complete: bool}
required.rule: dict {r_star_T, r_star_G, wp {T, G, branch}, combined_guard?, complete_inputs}

required.label: str
required.points: dict key -> {primary, s, b, sigma_ln, selections, expected_primary (= expected_toys.median), expected_toys {median, band_1s, band_2s} (PRIMARY, D4), expected_asymptotic {median, band_1s, band_2s} (cross-check), discovery {mu_3events, mu_5sigma, mu_3events_single_category?}}

limits.json.note: mu = signal events in the trigger + preselection acceptance in 3 ab^-1

workspaces/<key>.json.note: pyhf JSON workspace (schema 1.0.0), channels SR_T, SR_G

required.label: str
required.points: dict key (signal_eff key) -> {A_trig_presel, err_rel, level ('truth (Stage-3)'), factors {fiducial_eta25, trigger, preselection_given_trigger, PV (1, not modelled), finder_at_report_rungs {R_A..R_E}}, n_events, definition}

acceptance.json.note: sigma_95 = mu_95 / (L x A_trig_presel); eps_total = A x eps_finder (factorised chain, plan §3)

required.label: str
required.points: dict 'sample|spin|m' -> {lam_keV, truth (Stage-3 P2.json edges), R04/R14 -> {eff, lower {value keV, stat_err, definition}, upper {...}, b84_label}}

arrays: cls (0 PU in the signal event, 1 quirk, 2 PU-only fake)
